meta.title: Privacy
meta.description: How the campaign handles your personal data under Kenya's Data Protection Act, 2019.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: This site is run by the campaign to re-elect Hon. Hilary Kiplang'at Kosgei as MP for Kipkelion West. Data controller: [[TO CONFIRM: legal name and ODPC registration number]].

what.title: What we collect
what.body: Only what you type into our forms: name, phone, optional email, ward and your message or volunteer preferences. We don't use advertising trackers.

why.title: Why
why.body: To count pledges, organise volunteers and reply to you. Our lawful basis is your consent.

keep.title: How long
keep.body: Until 31 December 2027, then deleted, unless you ask us to delete it sooner.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under the Data Protection Act, 2019 you can access, correct or delete your data, withdraw consent, and complain to the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (odpc.go.ke).
